about.title: What is DevFest Yaoundé?
about.body: DevFest is Google's global series of developer-led, community events — and DevFest Yaoundé is our local chapter's flagship gathering, run by GDG Yaoundé for the people building things in and around this city. Expect real talks from real practitioners, hallway conversations that turn into collaborations, and a room full of people who'd rather be here than anywhere else.

community.title: What is GDG Yaoundé up to?
community.body: GDG Yaoundé keeps the community going all year, not just on event day — meetups, study jams, and a place to ask the questions you're too embarrassed to ask on Stack Overflow.
